column1: # LADDER.tsv — THE REBUS CONSTRUCT CENSUS. DECLARED, NEVER DERIVED; the LAST rung line is the TOP.
# Lon 2026-09-03 20:45: 100% = 100% of the industry standard language. Rebus has NO public conformance
# suite, so the REFERENCE censused into this ladder IS the standard and the ladder green to its top IS
# the score (ceo, row rebus-ladder-top-rung-census-from-the-rebus-report-is-the-score).
# SOURCE OF THE CENSUS: Griswold, "Rebus" TR 84-9 (/home/resources/REBUS tr84_9.pdf) — its construct
# table as already extracted into .github/GOAL-REBUS-100.md § THE MODEL, plus that file's native-frontend
# rung list RB-1..RB-14. Rebus is goal-directed like Icon with SNOBOL4-style pattern primitives, so the
# order below runs value -> control -> procedure -> data -> generator -> pattern, which is report order.
# ⛔ A RUNG DECLARED HERE AND NOT BUILT IS RED, NOT ABSENT. test_rebus_ladder.sh derives its population
# from ALL.csv's `ladder__rungNN_*` origins, so before this file existed `--to <top>` graded only the
# rungs that HAPPENED to exist and went green over the gaps. The runner now cross-checks this file and
# REFUSES rc=2 naming any declared rung with no witness.
# columns: rung  slug  construct (TR 84-9)  state
# ⛔ CONVERTED to the shared eight-column schema 2026-09-04 (hq_T), the ONE census shape for all seven
#    languages (ceo ruling: corpus/tests/<lang>/config/LADDER.tsv). It previously had NO HEADER LINE at
#    all, so util_ladder_forms_check.py REFUSED rc=2 on it and seat14's rebus ladder row parked on that.
# ⛔ FORMS ARE ENUMERATED FROM THE REFERENCE, NEVER FROM THE WITNESSES THAT HAPPEN TO EXIST. Back-filling
#    this column from ALL.csv would make the checker green by construction and prove nothing -- it is the
#    vacuous-green the checker was built to prevent. So only rungs 00 and 01 carry FORMS: seat14 read
#    TR 84-9 pp.13-15 for those two and minted a witness per form. Rungs 02-11 have an EMPTY FORMS cell
#    and the checker NAMES each one as owed -- that is the honest state, not a passing one.
RUNG
rung00
rung01
rung02
